publication.byte_preservation: Every raw JSON member and additional JSON receipt included as its exact original UTF8 value followed by its original terminal LF before the separator. All non-JSON members including JSONL journals, CPU and identity logs encoded base64; decoding reproduces every original byte and terminal newline. publication.interpretation: Eight noneligible controls compare existing wrapper and the same generic instructions/address with identical input/fill/output buffers, one worker and common amortized adapter crossing. Eligible strided target compares SIMD and generic algorithms, not wrapper overhead. No positive median wrapper-route tax for the three previously failed controls on this host; previous allocation-inclusive whole-call cause remains unresolved. No cross-host causal comparison, optimization acceptance, current-main speed claim or historical gate change.

prospective_contract.timed_boundary: One adapter call crossing, GIL release/acquire and fixed-loop prepared native calls. No output allocation, destruction, NumPy provider or oracle inside interval; identical crossing overhead for both routes. This differs deliberately from the public performance benchmark.
prospective_contract.compile_after_review: One C++17 PIC adapter TU against retained genuine SDK81 include and retained CPython3.11 headers, linked only as Python diagnostic module with -ldl; no libskimagexx.a link or product rebuild.
prospective_contract.host: Fresh host, no builds/tests; source/core/dependency/SDK closure authentication reused from admitted whole-product workflow; one CPU chosen from initially permitted affinity set if API available, otherwise explicitly unpinned.
prospective_contract.interpretation: Noneligible controls compare wrapper versus the identical generic operation/address and isolate wrapper-route tax under this diagnostic boundary; the eligible strided target compares SIMD versus generic algorithms and is not a wrapper-tax estimate. Compare absolute paired ns with generic/generic null pairs; retain all values and do not alter closed decisions.
prospective_contract.pair_order: Each of21 rounds randomizes wrapper/generic versus generic/null pair order, then randomizes route label order within each pair; one Random2026 stream across fixed9 cases.
prospective_contract.local_component_python: 3.11.14; component preflight only, not producer/timing equivalence
prospective_contract.partial_retention: Outside all clock intervals: exclusive initial JSONL header, case-start identity+oracle hash, each completed batch immediately saved pending output validation, validation marker after successful byte check; no retry/fsync. Native failure inside an unfinished batch cannot produce a completed batch time. Preserve prior journal records.

independent_review.scope: Prepared native same-core route comparison including common Python adapter crossing amortized across fixed loops.
